spot_ema.meaning: spotEMA value returned by OraclePack.getEMAs() at index 0

fast_ema.meaning: fastEMA value returned by OraclePack.getEMAs() at index 1

slow_ema.meaning: slowEMA value returned by OraclePack.getEMAs() at index 2

eons_ema.meaning: eonsEMA value returned by OraclePack.getEMAs() at index 3

tuple_assignment_positional.meaning: Solidity tuple assignment is positional, so unpacking binds by index order

twap_matches_intended.meaning: the TWAP tick consumed by PanopticPool.getTWAP()/dispatchFrom() equals the intended 0.6*fast + 0.3*slow + 0.1*eons, so StaleOracle() checks are not mismatched
twap_matches_intended.checkpoint: after twapEMA() computation, at StaleOracle() consumption

assumptions: The four EMA values are distinct so that positional misassignment produces a mathematically different TWAP.
The intended TWAP formula 0.6*fast + 0.3*slow + 0.1*eons is the system's own interpretation of getEMAs().

unresolved.description: Report does not give concrete numeric EMA values or a concrete StaleOracle() threshold, so the specific false-positive/false-negative outcome cannot be numerically instantiated; the qualitative mismatch relation is used.

limitations: Formalizes only the stale-oracle mismatch impact; solvency misclassification and liquidation pricing impacts are out of scope for this plan.
The intended TWAP is represented as a qualitative equality flag because the report supplies no concrete EMA values or StaleOracle threshold.
